text:
[Council File 24-1006]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the Amendment No. 4 to the agreement for Progressive Design-Build Services for San Fernando Groundwater Basin Remediation - Kiewit Infrastructure West Company.
Recommendation for Council action:
CONCUR with action of the Board of Water and Power Commissioners of August 25, 2026, Resolution No. 027 031, which approves the Amendment No. 4 to Agreement No. 47525 for Progressive Design-Build Services for San Fernando Groundwater Basin Remediation - Kiewit Infrastructure West Company. The proposed Amendment is to extend the term of the Agreement by one year for a total term of eight years ending September 8, 2027.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board of Water and Power Commissioners. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 25, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 23, 2026)
summary: Board of Water and Power Commissioners reported on Amendment No. 4 to the Progressive Design-Build Services agreement for San Fernando Groundwater Basin Remediation.
